title: Velocity Humanise
author: Cere, made with Claude
description: Velocity Humanise, after the Analog Rytm mod: every note trig plays a little louder or softer at random, by up to an amount you set per track in SETTINGS (HUMAN T1-T8 for the audio tracks, HUMAN MIDI for the MIDI tracks: OFF, 2-32). The pattern itself never changes. Settings are saved. Needs seq-events. Its rows sit in the MOD SETTINGS section when that mod is in the build.
